newsitem.title: DUBAI: BankWatch rates two United Arab Emirates banks.
newsitem.headline: BankWatch rates two United Arab Emirates banks.

text.p: New York-based Thomson BankWatch said in a statement that it had assigned ratings to the National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) and Commercial Bank of Dubai (CBD).

NBAD "received the highest intra-country issuer rating of A as a result of solid financial strength, excellent and dynamic management, liquidity, capital and a very low credit risk profile," BankWatch said.

"This is also the first bank in the United Arab Emirates rated by Thomson BankWatch to receive foreign currency ratings. The A+ long-term senior debt rating reflects not only the financial strength of the bank itself but also reflects the majority ownership by the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority".
It assigned CBD IC-A and LC-1 ratings. These "reflect an extremely well capitalised institution very sound asset quality, liquidity and a very solid management team".
